title: Coconut Tree
original_lyrics:
[verse]
(verse)
Everybody's got place they go
When the old battery gets running low.
I'm sucker for the sand and sea, yea
If I had my way, hey I' always be
Way up high in coconut tree
Layin' low, just my baby and me
Sunny sky as far as I can see
High up in coconut tree

[verse]
Not to green, not too brown,
I shimmy up and I shake the good ones down.

[chorus]
And you can do alright if you ain't afraid to be
High in coconut tree
Layin' low, just my baby and me
Sunny sky as far as I can see
High in coconut tree
Yeah, there's less stress and the world's alright
It's different point of view
When you're looking at life
Way up high in coconut tree
(Layin' low) low, just my baby and me
Sunny sky as far as I can see
High up in coconut
High in coconut tree (high in coconut tree)
Layin' low, just my baby and me
Sunny sky as far as I can see
High in coconut tree
High in coconut tree (high in coconut)
Layin' low, just my baby and me
Sunny sky as far as I can see
High in coconut tree
(sung simultaneously)
(Layin' low, just my baby and me)
Sunny sky as far as I can see
(High up in coconut tree)
High in coconut tree
Sunny sky as far as I can see
High up in coconut tree
Up here with Willie
Sunny sky as far as I can see
Let's get high in coconut tree
